action: General advice: keep iPhones on the latest iOS release; Confiant says a MoldyRoost ad's landing page is enough to infect an iPhone running a vulnerable iOS version.
date_note: Day of Confiant's post; Confiant says the activity it tracked ran from May 12 to Nov 17, 2026 and gives no single start day
exec: Confiant says ads alone can compromise vulnerable iPhones and target crypto wallet seed phrases, so staff phones holding wallets are exposed.
geo_basis: no single victim place; Confiant says over 47 countries were targeted
plain: An ad security firm, Confiant, says malicious online ads it calls MoldyRoost can infect iPhones on a vulnerable iOS version just by opening the ad's page, and are built to steal crypto wallet recovery phrases.

evidence.quote: Between May 12 and Nov 17, 2026, we tied 480+ ad domains to it, spread across six sub-clusters we label A to F.

summary: Confiant reported on 20 November an iOS malvertising operation it calls MoldyRoost: loading the landing page of one of its ads on an iPhone running a vulnerable iOS version is enough to infect it. Confiant tied 480+ ad domains to it between May 12 and Nov 17, 2026, with over 47 countries targeted (Japan among them, NADA NEWS reports). Confiant says the exploit kits used are built to exfiltrate crypto wallet seed phrases.
title: Confiant: MoldyRoost malvertising delivers iOS exploit kits that target crypto wallet seed phrases

validation.note: Single source: Confiant, the firm that found the activity, is the only origin (blog.confiant.com, 20 Nov, read). NADA NEWS (syndicated on Yahoo! Finance Japan) only relays Confiant and is not independent. Confiant names the Coruna, DarkSword, SilkPath and GhostWave exploit kits.

review.note: validation: marked corroborated although NADA NEWS only relays Confiant (not independent); now single_source. Title, date, 480+ ad domains, 47 countries, Japan, seed-phrase wording checked against the Confiant post and NADA/Yahoo Japan; 480+ is the source's own wording

key_findings: MoldyRoost buys programmatic ads and uses cloaking so that iPhones running Safari (or an in-app browser for some sub-clusters) are hit with iOS exploit chains when the landing page loads.
Confiant ties 480+ ad domains to it, active between 12 May and 17 November 2026, with over 47 countries targeted.
The operation did not write the exploit kits; it delivers Coruna, DarkSword, SilkPath and GhostWave, which Confiant says target crypto wallet seed phrases, keychain data, messages and photos.
Six sub-clusters (A to F) share one supply chain; a leaked source repository showed a version selector mapping iOS versions to one of four kits.
Confiant says whether one crew runs all sub-clusters or rents them to affiliates is yet to be determined.
